description: She wears an opaque plum-purple floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted paneled bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Fine gold woven borders decorate the neckline, vertical bodice seams, cuffs and hem. Red-purple jeweled gold clasps accent the shoulder straps and waist belt. An ivory patterned wrap edged in purple and gold rests across the forearms and falls at both sides. A pale ivory underlayer appears through the front skirt opening and decorated purple-brown closed shoes are visible below. Small gold earrings and a ring complete the outfit. Exact fiber cannot be confirmed.
